english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a choice or selection.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for an option, a selection, or the result of deciding.
This is the all-purpose choice among several alternatives.
This is the all-purpose noun for a choice or one of the possibilities available.
This is the all-purpose noun for the act of choosing or the choice someone makes.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for the available options or variety of products and services.
Use this for the choice among alternatives rather than for the resulting decision or a formal ruling.
Use this when the possibility means an option or choice available for the future.
